title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-27 06:26:01 最新章节：第963章 祖碑也一并打包詹台玄坤要龙凤结合
content_zh:
“老奴才，你在本宫这里行杂役一职距今已有百余载，本宫已知晓，你寿元将尽。”
“念在你兢兢业业百余载的份上，在你驾鹤西去前，可有何遗憾？本宫可尽力满足你。”
仙气飘飘的人工湖亭子里，一名身姿婀娜，长得沉鱼落雁，宛若谪仙般的紫衣仙子坐在石制茶桌前。
玉手撑着下巴，翘着二郎腿，语气颇显慵懒。
而在她面前，一名身穿粗布麻衣，两鬓斑白，干瘦苍老的老者单膝跪在地上。
嘴上的话说得好听，但紫衣仙子看向老者的眼中，充满了嫌弃之色。
“已经...一百年了吗？岁月真是不留人啊。”
老者语气微微颤抖，深陷的沧桑眸子中，既有对死亡的恐惧，亦有对自身的解脱。
他名林陌。
是诸多穿越众的一员。
一百多年前穿越到此方修仙界，但因天生灵脉低下，导致其修炼资质堪忧。
又因出生在贫困家庭，父母无奈之下，只能将他卖到这初圣宗来当杂役。
来到初圣宗之后，林陌还遭到了其他杂役弟子的欺凌和打压。
为了生存下去，他只能更加卖力地干活。
所幸，在几年之后，因为自身杂役工作干得出色，林陌被初圣宗掌门柳紫嫣相中，便安排他来到自己的寝宫负责杂役工作。
这一干，就是一百年。
按理说，干了百年杂役，没有功劳也有苦劳。
你说得对，但这里是初圣宗！
整个天渊大陆最臭名昭着的魔门宗派之一。
正所谓上梁不正下梁歪。

底下的弟子们尚且勾心斗角尔虞我诈，为了获得多一点的修炼资源，不惜欺凌、打压、出卖、背刺同门师兄弟。
更别说作为初圣宗掌门的柳紫嫣了。
对于林陌，百年来她始终只是将林陌视为一位下人，奴役。
用更难听一点的话来说，那就是狗。
今天突然这么好心的问林陌有什么临终遗愿，不过是她一时兴起，又或者说把林陌当做无聊时的玩弄工具罢了。
陪伴这位翻脸如翻书的掌门百年，林陌再是清楚不过她的性格了。
所以，林陌并未天真的以为，这是柳紫嫣突然善心大发。
“启禀掌门，老奴从小就进入初圣宗，对父母早已心无挂念，尔今寿元将尽，唯一的遗憾，便是如今仍是童子之身。”
因为即将油尽灯枯的原因，林陌说话都开始颤抖了，“老奴不敢有其他的奢望，只求掌门能赐老奴一名伴侣，陪老奴最后一程。”
柳紫嫣一听，乐了。
“呵呵，你这老奴倒是个贱种，死到临头了居然还想着这方面的事情，果然你们这些男人，都是一个模样，本宫倒是奇怪了，以你这副风中残烛的躯体，还有那方面的能力吗？”
柳紫嫣冷笑着，嗤之以鼻道。
“.........”
林陌没有说话。
按照常理来说，一百一十多岁的年纪，早就丧失男女方面的能力了。
但这里毕竟是修仙界。
林陌的修炼资质虽然有一点点差，但凭借着百年来积累的，那为数不多的灵力，他还是能让自己稍微支棱起来的。
不然，林陌也不会向柳紫嫣提此要求了。
“也罢，你这幅下流的德行，倒也符合我们初圣宗的风格，本宫便大发慈悲，赐你一名年轻女子。”
“本宫很想知道，像你这种风中残烛的躯体，究竟还具不具备那方面的能力呢？可不要让本宫失望啊。”
content_en:
"Old slave, you have been working as a handyman here for more than a hundred years. I already know that your life is about to end."
"For the sake of your hard work for more than a hundred years, do you have any regrets before you go west? I will do my best to satisfy you."
In the fairy-like artificial lake pavilion, a graceful purple-clothed fairy, as tall as a fish or a wild goose, is sitting in front of a stone tea table.
She held her chin with her hand, crossed her legs, and spoke in a rather lazy tone.
In front of her, a thin and old man wearing coarse linen clothes with gray hair on his temples was kneeling on the ground on one knee.
The words sounded nice, but the purple-clothed fairy looked at the old man with eyes full of disgust.
"Has it been...a hundred years? Time really doesn't leave anyone behind."
The old man's tone was slightly trembling, and in his deep-set eyes, there was both fear of death and relief from himself.
His name is Lin Mo.
He is a member of many time-travelling people.
He traveled to this world to cultivate immortality more than a hundred years ago, but due to his low natural spiritual veins, his cultivation qualifications were worrying.
And because he was born in a poor family, his parents had no choice but to sell him to the Chu Sheng Sect to work as a handyman.
After coming to Chu Sheng Sect, Lin Mo was bullied and suppressed by other handyman disciples.
In order to survive, he could only work harder.
Fortunately, a few years later, due to his outstanding performance in the handyman work, Lin Mo was spotted by Liu Ziyan, the head of Chu Sheng Sect, who arranged for him to come to his palace to take charge of the handyman work.
This will last a hundred years.
Logically speaking, after working as a handyman for a hundred years, there is no credit but hard work.
You are right, but this is the First Saint Sect!
One of the most notorious demon sects in the entire Tianyuan Continent.
As the saying goes, the upper beam is not straight and the lower beam is crooked.
The disciples below are even scheming and deceiving each other. In order to obtain more cultivation resources, they do not hesitate to bully, suppress, betray, and backstab their fellow disciples.
Not to mention Liu Ziyan, who is the head of the Chu Sheng Sect.
For Lin Mo, she had always regarded Lin Mo as a servant and a slave for hundreds of years.
To put it in a harsher way, it’s a dog.
Today, she suddenly asked Lin Mo so kindly what his last wish was, but it was just a whim, or she used Lin Mo as a tool to play with when she was bored.
After spending a hundred years with this fickle leader, Lin Mo knew her character very well.
Therefore, Lin Mo did not naively think that this was Liu Ziyan's sudden outpouring of kindness.
"Reporting to the leader, this old slave has been a member of the Chusheng Sect since he was a child. He has never cared about his parents. Your life is about to end, and your only regret is that you are still a boy."
Because the oil was about to run out, Lin Mo began to tremble when he spoke, "I don't dare to have any other extravagant wishes. I only hope that the master can give me a companion to accompany me on my last journey."
Liu Ziyan was happy when she heard this.
"Haha, you old slave is a bitch. You are still thinking about this matter when you are about to die. As expected, you men all look the same. I am surprised. With your body like a candle in the wind, do you still have the ability in this area?"
Liu Ziyan sneered and scoffed.
"..."
Lin Mo said nothing.
According to common sense, at the age of more than 110 years old, one has long lost the ability to be male and female.
But this is the world of cultivating immortals after all.
Although Lin Mo's cultivation qualifications were a little lacking, with the few spiritual powers he had accumulated over the past hundred years, he could still make himself stronger.
Otherwise, Lin Mo would not have made this request to Liu Ziyan.
"Forget it, your obscene virtues are in line with the style of our First Saint Sect, so I will be merciful and give you a young woman."
"I really want to know whether a body like yours, which is left in the wind, still has that kind of ability? Don't let me down."
